title: Help center localization sync — Tuesday 2026-10-13 (synthetic)

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Okay, let's start. The goal today is the Vietnamese help center launch.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Hi Sarah. Bên em đã dịch xong khoảng 80% articles rồi, còn phần billing thôi.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Great, thanks Vy. What's blocking the billing articles?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Billing articles có nhiều thuật ngữ, em cần anh Tuấn review terminology trước.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 3
transcript.text: Anh review được, nhưng tuần này anh bận release. Friday được không?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Friday is fine. Tuấn, you'll review the billing terminology by Friday, right?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 3
transcript.text: Yes, anh sẽ review billing terminology xong trước thứ Sáu.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Now the launch date. Marketing wants the Vietnamese help center live on October 20.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Nếu anh Tuấn review xong thứ Sáu thì em kịp, October 20 okay.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Then it's decided: the Vietnamese help center launches on October 20.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 3
transcript.text: Còn search thì sao? Search hiện tại không hiểu tiếng Việt có dấu.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Good point. Can the search handle Vietnamese diacritics?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 3
transcript.text: Cần bật Vietnamese analyzer cho search index. Việc đó nhỏ thôi.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Tuấn, can you enable the Vietnamese analyzer on the search index before launch?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 3
transcript.text: Ok, anh sẽ enable Vietnamese analyzer cho search index trước ngày launch.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Em đề xuất giữ URL tiếng Anh cho articles, chỉ dịch title và nội dung thôi.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I like that, it keeps the links stable. Let's keep English URLs for all articles.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 3
transcript.text: Đồng ý, như vậy redirect cũng đơn giản hơn.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Vy, can you send me a list of articles that still need screenshots?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Dạ được, em gửi chị danh sách articles cần screenshots trong hôm nay.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Perfect. Thanks both, cảm ơn nhé.

decisions: Launch the Vietnamese help center on October 20
Keep English URLs for all help center articles and translate only titles and content

actions.text: Review the billing terminology for the Vietnamese help center articles
Enable the Vietnamese analyzer on the help center search index before launch
Send Sarah the list of help center articles that still need screenshots
